currentParagraphText: “I don’t have that kind of money,” the Viper said, his hands raised in defense of his own poverty.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I don’t have that kind of money,” the Viper said, his hands raised in defense of his own poverty.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “No one told you to buy anything, but giving an extra number out shouldn’t be a problem, and besides, having more people there makes for more competitive betting even if you don’t bet yourself,” the man said, inviting the Viper into the auction hall itself.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Why the long face?” the beastkin running the auction said as he crossed his arms. “Just attend it yourself.”
